page_title: WER 1-0 MAI | Werder Bremen v Mainz 31/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Referee Martin Petersen has finally had enough of Ole Werner and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Mainz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+7' Paul Nebel (Mainz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Was it necessary? Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is shown a second yellow card for dissent and has to leave the pitch. Martin Petersen had no hesitation in issuing a red card!
90+3' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) receives a second yellow card and is sent off.
90+2' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Danny da Costa (Mainz) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is behind the touchline and Werder Bremen will take a throw-in.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Jung cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
83' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.

82' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
82' The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.
81' Bo Henriksen decides to make a substitution. Anthony Caci will be replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
81' A substitution has been made. Phillipp Mwene is replaced by Arnaud Nordin (Mainz).
80' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
78' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Martin Petersen and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' The substitution is prepared. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nelson Weiper.

76' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
73' The attendance for today's match is 40000.
70' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) replaces Issa Kabore.
70' Here comes a substitution. Marvin Ducksch is given a rest as he is replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
69' Paul Nebel (Mainz) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
68' The Mainz players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
65' The ball possession at the moment is 40:60.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
61' Danny da Costa (Mainz) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
58' Looks like Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
56' Stefan Bell is being substituted because of an injury. Bo Henriksen sends Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) on the pitch.
55' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
53' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.

51' Paul Nebel (Mainz) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner.
50' Michael Zetterer pulls off a fantastic save! Nelson Weiper (Mainz) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
50' Mainz work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
49' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Mainz will have a corner.
49' Mainz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.

47' A dangerous towering header by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
46' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mainz.
46' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Hyun-Seok Hong comes on the pitch for Nadiem Amiri (Mainz).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Anthony Caci (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Martin Petersen and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Paul Nebel (Mainz).
36' Leonardo Bittencourt is substituted due to injury. Ole Werner gives a chance to Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).
35' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
32' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

30' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the top of the net, but Robin Zentner made a superb athletic save to deny him.
28' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
27' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
27' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

23' Mainz slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
20' Mainz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Bo Henriksen (Mainz) gets a yellow card, off the field.
14' 1 - 0 A shot is blocked but the rebound lands at the feet of Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) who fires the ball into the back of the net.
14' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) will take the corner.
12' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but Robin Zentner leaps out to thwart his attempt.
12' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is going to take the penalty!
12' Referee Martin Petersen is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Mainz!
11' Celebrations by Mainz are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
9' Robin Zentner (Mainz) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Werder Bremen are awarded a penalty kick!
9' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Robin Zentner (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
8' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Mainz are taking a throw-in.
5' Robin Zentner comes off his line to intercept the corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen).

4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a decent header which rattles the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen will officiate today.
